meta.title: Synthetic small-molecule potency corpus
meta.note: Synthetic demonstration data. No BMS or client data.

cases.title: Lost qualifier + protocol context
cases.question: Would you include this potency observation in the model?
cases.context: Biochemical potency assay context recovered from ELN.
cases.lesson: The raw observation did not need to change. The missing scientific context and result semantics did.

cases.title: Protocol-version comparability
cases.question: Should this result be pooled with the main potency series?
cases.context: P2.0 uses a different ATP concentration and readout from P1.x; preserve the record but assign it to a separate assay domain unless comparability is demonstrated.
cases.lesson: Recovery can preserve evidence while still preventing inappropriate pooling.

cases.title: Negative evidence vs failed experiment
cases.question: Which observation should contribute negative evidence?
cases.lesson: A failed experiment is not negative scientific evidence. Conflating the two can distort training data.

cases.title: Compound identity mismatch
cases.question: Can this observation be assigned to the structure currently in the model table?
cases.context: Identity must be resolved against authoritative registration or source evidence before inclusion.
cases.lesson: Some records should remain ambiguous. The objective is defensible evidence, not maximising row count.

cases.title: Replicate relationship unclear
cases.question: Are repeated measurements technical replicates, biological repeats, or independent experiments?
cases.context: Replicate type and aggregation logic must be recovered before deriving a model label.
cases.lesson: Model-ready labels should be derived reproducibly from original observations rather than replacing them.
